scenario.topic: Choose a standing desk model for the shared office
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to you when picking a standing desk for our shared office—adjustability, price, or style?

options.name: Fully Electric Jarvis Standing Desk
options.upside: Smooth, quiet electric height adjustment with memory presets
options.tradeoff: Higher cost leaves less budget for accessories
options.concern: Electric components may require maintenance over time
options.best_for: users prioritizing ease of adjustability and tech features

options.name: IKEA Bekant Sit-Stand Desk
options.upside: Affordable with a clean modern design and decent height range
options.tradeoff: Lower weight capacity and less smooth adjustment compared to electric desks
options.concern: Manual crank version can be tiring to adjust frequently
options.best_for: budget-conscious users wanting decent quality and style

options.name: Flexispot Manual Crank Desk
options.upside: Lowest cost option with solid build and reliable manual crank
options.tradeoff: Manual adjustment can be slower and less convenient
options.concern: Height range may be limiting for taller users
options.best_for: users prioritizing cost savings and sturdy construction

options.name: Uplift V2 Standing Desk
options.upside: Highly customizable with strong frame and stable lifting system
options.tradeoff: Most expensive and longest assembly time within budget
options.concern: Complex assembly may require more effort or help
options.best_for: users valuing stability and customization options
